video_title: Bob Myers On Building A Championship Culture & Keeping A Winning Core Together

quotes.speaker: Bob Myers
quotes.summary_phrase: Bob Myers on the importance of how players react to losing
quotes.excerpt: I want to see what you look like when we lose. How you react to it.

text_blocks.speaker: Bob Myers
text_blocks.text: How much do you hate to lose? If I walked in the locker room and you were on the team I was a GM of and we lost, I want to see what you look like. How you react to it. It may be you don't say anything. It may be you are laughing. It may be you are pissed for three days. It may be that whatever you are or whatever you do, I want to know that part.

quotes.speaker: Bob Myers
quotes.summary_phrase: Bob Myers on the difficulty of finding leadership in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: It is very hard to find leadership at any level.
quotes.quote: I asked Jermaine O'Neal, we need some leadership. There is not enough of that either, by the way, in the NBA. It is very hard to find leadership at any level. So I thought our team needed it, and Jermaine is a very, very good leader, I think. He came to the team, we lost the Clippers in seven games, and he was banged up, trying to play, his wrist was jacked. We lost in seven games and I am looking at the team going, well, Steph is looking like he could be something, Klay, Harrison Barnes, some of our young guys. Jermaine calls me three days after we lost and I am thinking he is going to tell me he is retiring or whatever. He says, 'Hey man, listen to me, do not break this team up.' I was kind of like, what is so great about this team? We just lost in the first round. He says, 'I have been in a lot of locker rooms at the end of a season and this team knows how to lose.' It bothered them the right amount.

quotes.speaker: Bob Myers
quotes.summary_phrase: Bob Myers on players prioritizing the All-Star Game over team success
quotes.excerpt: I did not understand how much players want to make the All-Star Game.
quotes.quote: I am always surprised, and I would love to hear your point. I did not understand how much players want to make the All-Star Game. You guys have to be honest because I remember talking to Igor Kokoskov one year and I go, what are we doing? We were a team, he goes, All-Star Game. We tell the All-Star Game is over and then we will be right. It is not the money, you guys had enough money. It was the status. You get like from the shoe deal, from some teams or whatever, but it is like you can say, Tracy McGrady, NBA All-Star. That kind of follows it. It solidifies you as a notch on the belt.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter on convincing Jaylen Brown not to break up the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: I see a championship out of y'all two at some point.
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown came to me, came to my house and we had a sit down. He had some things that, and this was many years ago before they won a championship. There was a lot of talk circulating around breaking up this core with him and Jayson Tatum. So and I was watching how they played with each other year after year and this particular year they fell short. It was a year where he was frustrated and was thinking about making a change. The media is talking, the fans are talking. I said, Jaylen, you got some good, bro. Don't break this up because I see a championship out of y'all two at some point.

quotes.speaker: Bob Myers
quotes.summary_phrase: Bob Myers on the lack of honest conversations in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: There is not a lot of honest conversations in the NBA, I don't think.
quotes.quote: There is not a lot of honest conversations in the NBA, I don't think. Coaches are often scared to get fired, and especially with guys like you, they are not going to mess with guys like you in a film session, in a practice, in a game. That is why I miss Jeff Van Gundy, bro. That is why I hate that once he stopped coaching the Rockets he did not coach no more, because what you are describing is a coach that is the total opposite of that. He is one of those coaches that he is going to tell you what you don't want to hear but what you need to hear, and he is an honest coach.

quotes.speaker: Bob Myers
quotes.summary_phrase: Bob Myers on the immense power of NBA players
quotes.excerpt: Do you understand the power of an NBA player? Do you guys actually understand?
quotes.quote: Do you understand the power of an NBA player? Do you guys actually understand, as far as any other sport? The only power that is equivalent to an NBA star is an NFL quarterback, and they don't act like they when a team loses in the NFL, let's say you guys lost in a playoff game, you are up there 30 minutes after you lost, hey, you think this team is good enough? What do you think about requesting a trade? You think you are going to stick around? The media doesn't do that to the NFL quarterback. They don't push him to say, you need to get out of here to win. Whereas you guys, now you have got so much power and if one of you two in the prime of your career, all you have to do is this, let's say I am the GM, hey, I am done here. Do you understand that could mess up the organization for five years?
